complaint: Claim handling delays: "I filed weeks ago and nothing is happening."
evidence: NAIC closed confirmed complaints: Claim Handling Delays 12,411 (17.77%), top reason in one reported period; 11,916 (17.14%) as of May 30, 2019. NAIC column years are not labeled in the extract.
root_cause: Missing documents requested late or to the wrong channel; no shared clock; handoffs between desk, field, and vendors

complaint: Unsatisfactory settlement or offer: "The offer is way below what it costs to fix."
evidence: NAIC: 11,498 (16.46%) in one period; 4,314 (17.39%) top reason in another.
root_cause: Estimate line items, pricing databases, depreciation and ACV math, missing scope

complaint: Claim denied.
root_cause: Exclusion wording, late notice, missing proof, coverage version on file

complaint: Prompt pay: paid late after agreement.
evidence: NAIC: Prompt Pay 4,811 (6.89%) in one period.
root_cause: Payment holds for missing W-9, mortgagee on check, address mismatch

complaint: Repairs and final payment take too long.
evidence: J.D. Power 2025: 32.4 days filing to repair, 44+ days FNOL to final payment, longest since 2008; satisfaction 762 (<10 days) vs 595 (>31 days).
root_cause: Catastrophe volume, contractor scheduling, supplements and re-inspections

complaint: Total loss valuation feels low.
evidence: J.D. Power 2025: total losses 27% of claims; only 58% said valuation fully met expectations.
root_cause: Comparable-vehicle selection, condition adjustments, option codes from VIN decode

complaint: Afraid to file a claim because rates will rise; higher deductibles.
evidence: J.D. Power 2025: 7% avoided filing for fear of rate increase; 26% have deductibles of $1,000+.
root_cause: Opaque surcharge rules; deductible changes at renewal not noticed

complaint: Repairs slower on cars with safety tech.
evidence: J.D. Power 2025: 17.9 days (no ADAS, MY2015 and older) vs 21.5 days (3+ ADAS, MY2019+).
root_cause: Calibration steps, OEM procedures, parts availability

complaint: Non-renewed after years with the same carrier.
evidence: Weiss Ratings (NAIC data): FL 3.35%, CA 3.18% non-renewal in 2024; Utah 4.45% in 2025. Senate Budget Committee dataset 2018 to 2023, ~65% of market.
root_cause: Appetite and catastrophe model changes; notice timing rules vary by state

complaint: Carrier leaving the state.
evidence: QBE exiting US homeowners; 37,774 California homes; CA requires 75 days notice before nonrenewal; moratoria after declared emergencies.
root_cause: Notice-period and moratorium rules per state; ZIP-level eligibility

complaint: Policy cancelled or non-renewed.
evidence: NAIC: Underwriting Cancellation 3,070 (4.42%) as of May 2019. Illinois 2025: underwriting 14.4% of complaint reasons.
root_cause: Inspection findings, roof age, payment lapse, data errors

complaint: Renewal premium jumped with no explanation.
evidence: Washington OIC rule R 2024-07 requires explanations; automatic notice at 10%+; top three factors from Jan 2027. NAIC premium-increase transparency guidance.
root_cause: Rating factors spread across systems; agents can't see the drivers

complaint: No response or slow response.
evidence: NAIC: PolicyHolder Service Delays/No Response 2,699 (3.88%) as of May 2019.
root_cause: Shared inboxes, handoffs, no owner

complaint: Premium billing errors and refunds.
evidence: NAIC as of May 2019: Premium Notice/Billing 2,557 (3.68%); Premium Refund 2,289 (3.29%).
root_cause: Mid-term changes, pro-rata vs short-rate math, rounding, payment posting

complaint: Adjuster handling: rude, unreachable, changed adjusters.
evidence: NAIC: Claim Handling Adjuster Handling 2,272 (3.27%) as of May 2019.
root_cause: Catastrophe staffing, independent adjuster churn, file notes not transferred

complaint: Depreciation held back; confusion about getting it released.
evidence: Multiple forum threads (r/Insurance, r/adjusters) on ACV first, recoverable depreciation after repair.
root_cause: ACV vs RCV math; completion proof requirements; labor depreciation

complaint: Siding or shingles won't match; insurer won't pay for undamaged areas.
evidence: IRMI commentary and PropertyCasualty360 coverage Q&A on matching disputes and exclusions.
root_cause: State matching rules vs policy exclusion; discontinued products

complaint: Roof paid at a fraction because of age schedule.
evidence: Agent and underwriting publications describe roof ACV and payment schedules; can pay ~20% for older composition roofs per one schedule.
root_cause: Endorsement not explained at sale; roof age data wrong

complaint: Cosmetic hail exclusion surprise.
evidence: PIIAC agents E&O guidance on growing cosmetic hail exclusions.
root_cause: Endorsement added at renewal; disclosure not documented

complaint: Prior authorization denied, then overturned on appeal.
evidence: KFF: 2025 standard PA denials 12% MA, 14% Medicaid MC, 18% ACA; 67% of appealed MA denials overturned.
root_cause: Missing clinical documentation; code mismatch; requests rarely appealed

complaint: In-network claims denied, reason unclear.
evidence: KFF: HealthCare.gov insurers denied 19% of in-network claims in 2023; 'other' 34%, administrative 18%, no prior auth or referral 9%.
root_cause: Administrative errors, ID mismatches, missing auth numbers, coding

complaint: Claim denied or benefits late.
evidence: Minnesota DLI 2026 report: 17.4% denial rate (non-COVID, 2024 injuries). NY WCB 2025: 90% received first benefits timely.
root_cause: Late employer report, disputed causation, missing medical

complaint: Delayed time-loss benefits, treatment, and bill payment.
evidence: Washington legislative report lists delayed time-loss, treatment, bill payment among leading complaints.
root_cause: Wage data, provider billing codes, authorization

complaint: Claim contested in first two years for application misstatement.
evidence: WSJ Buyside explainer on contestability; Texas appellate case American National v. Arce.
root_cause: Medical record vs application answers; agent filled in application

complaint: Proof-of-loss deadline missed.
evidence: Attorney guidance 2026; insurers often must show prejudice.
root_cause: Death certificate delays; notice sent to old address

complaint: Benefits go unclaimed; family never knew about the policy.
evidence: State laws require Death Master File matching (KY, WY semiannual; FL annual) and beneficiary outreach.
root_cause: Name and SSN matching against DMF; stale addresses

complaint: Deductible not refunded after insurer recovered from the other party.
evidence: Washington case (Averill v. Farmers) on deductible reimbursement; law-firm and consumer guides on delays.
root_cause: Recovery posted to claim but deductible refund not triggered; pro-rata recovery math

complaint: Sold an annuity that didn't fit.
evidence: Connecticut 2025: Marketing & Sales 40.83% of annuity complaints.
root_cause: Suitability documentation; replacement forms

complaint: Late notice of a claim to the reinsurer.
evidence: Fifth Circuit 2025 (No. 24-10392): late notice prejudiced reinsurer.
root_cause: Notice thresholds in treaty not tied to reserve movements

complaint: How many events? Aggregation and hours clauses.
evidence: Artemis and Husch Blackwell on California wildfire hours-clause questions.
root_cause: Loss timestamps, event definitions, clause versions

complaint: Follow-the-fortunes doesn't cover everything.
evidence: Practitioner commentary: does not override express treaty terms or bad faith.
root_cause: Settlement outside treaty terms; documentation of good faith

complaint: Bordereaux late or poor quality.
evidence: Lloyd's Coverholder Reporting Standards v5.1 and DA data conditions of trade.
root_cause: Spreadsheet field types, units, dates, missing fields

complaint: AI-edited photos and documents.
evidence: Verisk: 98% of insurers say AI editing tools fuel digital media fraud; 99% encountered manipulated docs.
root_cause: Metadata, provenance, reused images

complaint: Claims handling dominates complaints overall.
evidence: Illinois 2025: claims handling 64.8% of complaint reasons. Connecticut 2025: claim handling 83.4% of A&H, 66.2% of homeowners complaints.
root_cause: Same root causes as 1 to 4
